verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere ships inference engines (MetalRT, a C++ core, and hosted Wally cloud inference), so KV-cache memory management is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions paged attention, KV-cache paging, fragmentation handling, or concurrent-request capacity. The hardware-acceleration and benchmark claims are about a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on paged memory management for attention key/value cache to maximize concurrent request capacity without memory fragmentation
